title: Ticket triage
headline: Every ticket in the right queue in milliseconds, and the urgent ones first.
context: Customer service center of Nexa Energía, an electricity and gas retailer. Tickets arrive by email, web, WhatsApp, social media and transcribed calls, in several languages.

cola.instructions: Which team should handle the main issue in this ticket?

criteria.averias: Faults and emergencies: no power or no gas, service interruptions, gas smell, downed cables, sparks, faulty meter.
criteria.facturacion: Billing and payments: amounts, duplicate charges, meter readings, non-payment, installment plans, bono social (social discount), refunds.
criteria.contratacion: Contracts: new sign-ups, cancellations, change of account holder, moves, change of rate plan or contracted power.
criteria.autoconsumo: Solar self-consumption: panels, inverter, batteries, surplus compensation.
criteria.movilidad: Electric mobility: charging stations, home charger, charging app or card.
criteria.reclamaciones: Formal complaints: escalated complaint, threat to report the company, consumer protection agency, lawyer or going public.
criteria.otros: Any other inquiry: sponsorships, employment, press, topics unrelated to the energy supply.

urgencia.instructions: How urgently does this ticket need to be handled?
criteria: Low: informational inquiry or administrative procedure with no immediate impact.
Medium: real problem that can wait a few days.
High: significant impact today, such as being without supply or a major incorrect charge.
Critical: risk to people or property, or a dependent person affected right now.

riesgo_seguridad.instructions: Does the message describe an immediate physical danger in the installation or on the grid (gas smell, downed cables, sparks, smoke, fire, electric shocks)?

cliente_vulnerable.instructions: Does the customer mention a vulnerable situation (an elderly or dependent person, electrical medical equipment at home, children at risk or serious financial hardship)?

riesgo_baja.instructions: Does the customer threaten or hint at canceling their service or leaving for another company?

items.text: Good morning, on the September bill you charged me twice for the same amount (€84.32). I'm attaching the bank statement. Can you refund the duplicate charge?
There's a really strong smell of gas in the lobby and on the stairs, the neighbors are going down to the street. What should we do?
My mother is 87 and uses an oxygen concentrator. She's had no power since 6 in the morning at Calle Mayor 12 in Valladolid. Please, it's urgent.
Third time I've called about the same bill and nobody fixes it. If it's not resolved by Monday I'm switching to a competitor and filing a complaint with the consumer protection office. @NexaEnergia
I want to lower my contracted power from 5.75 kW to 4.6 kW to save money. Is there any cost for the change?
There's a power cable hanging from a pole and throwing sparks right next to the school on Calle Olmo.
I'm out of work and can't pay the last two bills. Can I split the debt into installments or apply for the bono social (social discount)? I have two small kids.
Transcript: the customer asks what the difference is between the time-of-use rate plan and the fixed rate plan, and which one suits them better if they work from home.
The battery in my solar installation hasn't charged since last week's inverter update.
Do you sponsor the city marathon? I'd like to send you a collaboration proposal for the 2027 edition.
I've received a shutoff notice for non-payment, but all my bills are paid. I need you to stop it right now: my father lives in the house and he's dependent on care.

notes.reto: Hundreds of thousands of contacts a month by email, web, WhatsApp and social media, in several languages. Sorting and prioritizing by hand takes minutes per ticket and delays precisely the critical cases (gas smell, vulnerable customers).
notes.solucion: Decision-1 reads each ticket and answers 5 closed questions in a single call: queue, urgency and 3 alerts (safety, vulnerable customer, churn risk), each with calibrated probabilities.
notes.paradigma: It doesn't write, it decides. That's why it fits inline with every incoming event at a fraction of the cost of an LLM. Calibrated confidence sets the cutoff: above the threshold it is automated; below it, human review.
